sources.title: Bethesda Support: Overseer, Overseen (Fallout 76)
sources.supports: Overseer, Security Chief Robinson, Head Engineer Brass, Doctor Loris and Professor-Bot are quest roles; the scenario is a Vault-Tec University training simulation.
sources.limit: Does not establish an exhaustive corporate personnel chart or real job specification.

sources.title: Bethesda Support: Reclamation Day (Fallout 76)
sources.supports: Pip-Boy, Overseer's Mission, Vault 76 departure and Wasteland exploration.
sources.limit: The title Reclamation Scout is an adaptation, not an attested Vault-Tec position.

sources.title: Bethesda: Fallout Shelter
sources.supports: Overseer administration, Dwellers' assigned jobs, radio and Vault protection and wasteland exploration.
sources.limit: Neither Records Custodian nor University Researcher is represented here as an exact canonical employee title.

sources.title: ONVIF Profile T
sources.supports: Current camera video interoperability target: H.264/H.265, imaging, metadata and alarm features.
sources.limit: Interoperability depends on tested camera/client conformity and codec support.

sources.title: ONVIF: Transition away from Profile S
sources.supports: Profile S deprecation; Profile T preferred for newer integrations.
sources.limit: Legacy cameras may still require separately tested paths.

sources.title: IETF RFC 7826: RTSP 2.0
sources.limit: Does not imply every consumer camera implements RTSP 2.0; compatibility must be negotiated and tested.

sources.title: IETF RFC 7946: GeoJSON
sources.supports: GeoJSON positions are longitude-latitude in WGS 84 (CRS84 axis order).
sources.limit: Location data may be sensitive and must be protected by explicit storage/sharing policy.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-92: Computer Security Log Management
sources.supports: Planning and management of incident logs and evidence.

sources.title: W3C WCAG 2.2
sources.supports: Readable controls, input targets and keyboard operability guide handheld UI acceptance.
sources.limit: A desktop terminal prototype does not establish WCAG conformance for a future handheld.

sources.title: Rust-Boy role architecture
sources.supports: Role preset IDs, currently pinned tool sets and independent Custom sandbox.
sources.limit: Code presence on development branch is not cross-platform CI acceptance.

sources.title: OpenGeos RustGIS — architecture, licensing, ARM64 builds
sources.supports: RustGIS L0 geometry and L1 data are useful interoperability references; Apache-2.0, available Linux ARM64 distribution; workspace minimum Rust 1.90.
sources.limit: Rust-Boy now declares Rust 1.90, removing the compiler-version mismatch. RustGIS crates are not linked yet; integration still requires API/license and ARM64 GUI/CLI verification.

sources.title: TAK Product Center — ATAK, TAKX, PiTAK, TAK Server
sources.supports: ATAK-CIV is Android software, TAKX includes a Linux variant, and PiTAK is a transport-specific TAK ecosystem product.
sources.limit: PiTAK does not imply an entire ATAK mobile client on Raspberry Pi OS; Linux TAKX ARM64 support has not been established.

sources.title: OpenTAKServer — Raspberry Pi OS installation
sources.supports: OpenTAKServer supports Raspberry Pi OS Bookworm-or-newer with a documented Pi installer; this is a TAK-compatible server for client data exchange.
sources.limit: Separate software, not embedded in Rust-Boy; operator must review installer, certificates, access policy and live ARM64 hardware behavior.

sources.title: IETF RFC 7946 — GeoJSON
sources.supports: Positions use geographic longitude, latitude WGS84 axis order; GeoJSON Feature and FeatureCollection are suitable portable interchange artifacts.
sources.limit: Raw bounding boxes may be broad across antimeridian; the bounded Scout CLI inspector supports Point through Polygon geometry and GeometryCollections but does not render maps.

roles.name: Overseer
roles.mission: Lead operations: create and prioritize assignments, track completion, assign staff by job, and record manual task handoffs and acknowledgments.

needs.need: At-a-glance system/companion health and truthful stale states
Persistent delegated mission tasks with assignee, role, priority, due date, status, and manual acknowledgment
Manual email/clipboard task handoff, local status tracking, immutable-revision edit conflicts, and audit history
Opt-in live sources and redacted report export

gates.title: Preset, launch and honest status
deliverables: Overseer selected by default on a fresh install
Five pre-pinned tools including Task Control are visible and inert until launched
Existing boards survive upgrade
acceptance: Fresh install shows Overseer profile without writing until user changes it
No automatic PlayStation/network connection
Linux/macOS/Windows CI passes

gates.title: Offline command desk
deliverables: Persistent local Task Control: create/assign/reassign, priority, due dates, status and acknowledgment
Explicit copy/email-draft handoffs and manually confirmed sending; local event log and revision conflicts
At-a-glance micro/desktop role-aware task queues and operator summaries
acceptance: Create, complete and reassign ten tasks offline with restart persistence and validation
Attempted stale revisions fail without overwriting; corrupt/future board preserved
No mail, camera, network or background notification is sent by loading a profile; delivery is not inferred

gates.title: Consent-based integrations
deliverables: Explicitly connected game observations and permitted sensor status
Incident-to-task linking and event acknowledgment
acceptance: Disconnect immediately marks readings stale
No network activity until a user explicitly connects

gates.title: Field command acceptance
deliverables: Resource-aware handheld overview
Signed/redacted local reports and restore
acceptance: Operator completes status-task-report journey on 4-inch target
Storage rollback and interrupted write are tested

roles.name: Maintenance
roles.mission: Troubleshoot embedded systems, networks and hardware using reproducible diagnostics.

needs.need: Hex dumps, checksums, IPv4/CIDR math, host diagnostics and fixture runs
Device inventory and repeatable diagnostic recipes
Read-only USB/serial log console with explicit scope
Physical GPIO, environmental sensors and managed test rigs

gates.title: Ready engineering desk
deliverables: Pinned host/NET/BYTE/SIM/NOTES palette
Offline CIDR, byte dump and CRC32 commands
acceptance: Golden CIDR /24 /31 /32 and CRC32 vectors pass
All tools remain inactive until invoked

gates.title: Real offline engineering lab
deliverables: Bounded hex/file-header inspector and developer test recipes
Diagnostic session reports with reproducible parameters
acceptance: Input limits and invalid file/hex handling tested
Fixture replay produces the same output on repeat

gates.title: OS-authorized device diagnostics
deliverables: Separately reviewed read-only serial gateway
Device identity, per-device consent, expiry and hot-unplug
acceptance: USB device cannot open without OS permission and explicit session grant
Unplug/revoke closes handles and clears buffers

gates.title: Embedded hardware integration
deliverables: Sensor modules and typed adapter SDK
Battery/runtime budgets and device-specific compatibility matrix
acceptance: Physical device tested on macOS and chosen handheld prototype
No transmission capability is implied by receiver diagnostics

roles.name: Security
roles.mission: Protect the operator environment using local diagnostics, task tracking and labeled public camera fallback views while private camera integration remains gated.

needs.need: Four-camera 2x2 wall with one-key focus and back
Manual, permissioned import of IP cameras (JPEG/MJPEG first; RTSP/ONVIF later)
Per-feed connected/loading/stale/disconnected/auth-error state and timestamps
Minimal network/incident diagnostics and bounded evidence notes
Opt-in motion/alarm events, export and optional PTZ

gates.title: Security desk baseline
deliverables: Pinned host, network math, byte inspection and notes
No camera connection without explicit configuration
acceptance: Security profile renders without claiming feeds live
Offline baseline is usable without network

gates.title: Four-feed UI with deterministic camera fixtures
deliverables: 2×2 thumbnail wall and four separate feed state machines
1–4 choose, Enter expands, Esc returns, loading/error/stale labels
4-inch readable layout and input focus
acceptance: All four synthetic feeds animate independently
Focus/back and missing/stale feeds tested at 800×480 and compact fallback
No external endpoints contacted

gates.title: Authorized real camera streams
deliverables: Manually entered allowlisted HTTPS JPEG/MJPEG sources
Per-camera credentials in secure OS storage; strict TLS verification and redaction
RTSP H.264/H.265 decoder path and ONVIF Profile T compatibility by model
acceptance: Four verified real feeds display simultaneously and can focus
No URLs/credentials in logs or public config
No surprise recording/discovery, audio or PTZ

gates.title: Operational security acceptance
deliverables: Reconnect/backoff, bandwidth and frame freshness indicators
Optional local events and user-confirmed evidence export
Unplug, timeout, session expiry and offline recovery
acceptance: Stale frames never carry a live indicator
Operator selects feed <1s under lab fixture load
Camera field matrix documents latency/memory/CPU on Mac and handheld

roles.name: Doctor
roles.mission: Maintain non-diagnostic health/environment reference and field observations without exposing patient records.

needs.need: Trusted offline medical/public-health references with provenance
Environmental observations: temperature, humidity, water and air quality (non-medical)
Structured checklists with source-linked thresholds and units
Explicitly consented sensors and privacy-governed exports

gates.title: Research-and-notes starter
deliverables: Offline library, manual notes and host condition tools
acceptance: No health inference or clinical diagnosis is claimed
No protected patient data are seeded

gates.title: Environmental observation desk
deliverables: Manual readings with units, timestamps and missing-value explanations
Hazard-specific safety checklists backed by references
acceptance: Synthetic and real/manual readings distinguish provenance
Out-of-range values do not trigger unsupported medical recommendations

gates.title: Opt-in environmental sensing
deliverables: Approved temperature/humidity and non-clinical sensor adapters
Calibration record, source quality and stale-device warnings
acceptance: Consent and calibration test gates pass
No clinical sensor device claimed compliant by default

gates.title: Field validation and privacy
deliverables: Accessible checklist export
Privacy review before any person-specific data flow
acceptance: No plaintext protected health record workflow offered by default
End-to-end offline reference-checklist-export acceptance

roles.name: Scientist
roles.mission: Run small, reproducible experiments and inspect data without requiring proprietary applications.

needs.need: Reproducible sampling and synthetic test runs
CSV/JSON inspection, simple descriptive statistics and unit-aware charts
Experiment manifest, seeds and deterministic export
Restricted plugin sandbox for advanced computation

gates.title: Preloaded research bench
deliverables: Byte, reference, note, simulator and subnet tools
acceptance: All experiments identified as synthetic where appropriate
No arbitrary scripts executed on profile activation

gates.title: Offline data lab
deliverables: Bounded CSV/JSON import and schema reporting
Count/mean/median/variance and small-screen sparkline viewer
acceptance: Known numerical fixtures agree with trusted reference values
Invalid, huge and missing inputs fail without changing raw data

gates.title: Reproducible sessions
deliverables: Versioned experiment manifest with parameter set, seed and source hash
Saved/replayable in-memory simulation recipes
acceptance: Exact replay generates matching deterministic artifacts
No implicit upload or network access

gates.title: Optional advanced computation
deliverables: Versioned typed WASM plugin contract with capability gates
Snapshot/restore and independent process isolation tests
acceptance: Untrusted plugin cannot read files, network or hardware without external enforcement
Process crash leaves project usable

roles.name: Reclamations
roles.mission: Build a truly offline WGS84 field kit on Mac and Pi, interoperable with RustGIS and eventually opt-in TAK nodes.

needs.need: Local WGS84 waypoints, approximate great-circle distances and bounded GeoJSON geometry inspection
Offline trip notes, saved landmarks and position uncertainty labels
Opt-in GNSS, multi-geometry GeoJSON/GPX exchange and permitted TAK CoT interoperability
Portable RustGIS-style map rendering, offline tile caching and Raspberry Pi display performance

gates.title: Preloaded field desk
deliverables: Pre-pinned GIS Lab plus Game, NET, notes and host tools
Offline waypoint GeoJSON, spherical distance and bounded Point-only file inspection
acceptance: GeoJSON exports [longitude,latitude] and accepts only -90..90 lat and -180..180 lon
All GIS commands remain offline with no GNSS, console or TAK connection on profile activation
Unit, smoke and Rust 1.90/macOS/Windows CI gates pass before release

gates.title: Offline RustGIS-compatible field mapping
deliverables: Portable GeoJSON field layer, GPX imports, waypoints and manually selected cached offline tiles
Evaluate rustgis-geom/rustgis-data adapter separately, using the new Rust 1.90 minimum with explicit dependency and API tests
Touch/keyboard map navigation and DMS coordinate formats
acceptance: RustGIS reads exported waypoint layers and Rust-Boy inspects RustGIS Point layers without conversion errors
Golden dateline, polar, invalid-coordinate and lossless waypoint round trips
No network access required for local map navigation

gates.title: Opt-in GNSS and TAK interoperability
deliverables: Explicit OS-granted GNSS with accuracy/stale indicators and revocation
Bounded Cursor-on-Target XML/Protobuf adapter with operator-selected destinations and TLS identity
Test with independent OpenTAKServer on Raspberry Pi OS and a civilian TAK client
acceptance: No position sharing before the user enables it, selects recipient and approves each session
Local CoT fixture tests pass; live Pi server interoperability is field-tested and credential-safe
Revocation stops transmission and marks positions stale

gates.title: Raspberry Pi handheld GIS acceptance
deliverables: ARM64 Pi 5 native Scout build and tested RustGIS ARM64 deployment
Four-inch readout with waypoint and offline map controls, keyboard/touch fallback
Power/performance measurements plus independent Mac/PS4 game companion acceptance
acceptance: Offline waypoint, coordinate and cached-map use passes on actual Pi hardware
Measured cold start, frame latency, RAM/CPU and battery draw recorded without guessed metrics
TAK server/client and PlayStation tests are reported separately from mock connections

roles.name: Archivist
roles.mission: Catalog documents and make integrity, provenance and export understandable.

needs.need: Fast local index and search without uploading content
SHA-256 file integrity, not CRC32 as a security claim
Source citations, tagged records, import/export and schema migration
Versioned optional encrypted archives and trusted sharing

gates.title: Curated archive desk
deliverables: Library, notes and byte-lab tools
acceptance: Notes remain local/plaintext with warnings
References and URLs preserve third-party licensing context

gates.title: Integrity workflow

Source tag, timestamp, provenance and searchable index
